properties.name: TemporalFact has no declared `name`, and 49 of 429 facts carry one anyway — create_node reports it as `undeclared` on every write
properties.statement: MEASURED 2026-09-06 on the export: 429 TemporalFacts, 49 carrying a non-empty `name` (11%), and schema/temporal.yaml declares no `name` on the type — so every create_node that writes one gets `undeclared: ["name"]` in its reply, four times in one session here. The property is READ: search_design renders a fact's name in every hit, and the gap and ledger surfaces name facts by it when present and fall back to the id when not. The shape is the one fact:defect-half-the-temporal-facts-date-themselves-where-nothing-reads named for valid_from — a MISSING WORD, evidenced by consistent undeclared use — at a smaller scale. Not established: whether the 380 nameless facts are nameless because the constructor path (there is no add_temporal_fact tool; facts are written with create_node) never offered one. Cheap fix: declare `name` on TemporalFact (indexed, fulltext), as valid_from was declared on 2026-08-16 for the same reason. Recorded under rule:a-reflow2-tool-failure-met-while-working-is-captured-as-a-to-do.
